description.text: Duration4 yearsDegree AwardedQualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Clinical Pharmacy by Wenzhou Medical UniversityFuture CareerGraduates can work in the production, technology development, and applied research of pharmaceutical products, design and management of pharmaceutical companies in the pharmaceutical, fine chemical and bio-chemical fields, or choose to apply for graduate degree programs.

duration.text: The Clinical Pharmacy at Wenzhou Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Applicants must provide true and correct information of the following application documents in the online application system:1.Application form for International Students of Wenzhou Medical University. The form will be automatically generated after applicants complete the information in the online application system, and applicants should upload the signature;2.Transcript from high school with the official stamp (scanned color copies of original or notarized copies in Chinese or English);3.High school diploma or equivalent certificate (fresh graduates can provide pre-graduation certificate first) (scanned color copies of original or notarized copies in Chinese or English);4.Ordinary passport within the validity period (Scanned color copy);5.Digital color photo in white background (Format: JPG:100-500KB);6.Financial guarantee certificate (parents' income certificate or bank deposit certificate);7.Applicants whose native language is not English speaking should provide the scanned color copies of proof of English proficiency test (such as IELTS, TOEFL, etc. For MBBS program, IELTS no less than 6.0 and each item no less than 5.0; TOEFL no less than 70 and each item no less than 15) or proof of a medium-of-instruction certificate in English during high school;8.Other supplementary documents require by WMU.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens aged between 18-30 (in principle) with a valid passport (according to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China);(1) According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, the applicant has acquire foreign nationality at birth and does not have Chinese nationality, whose parents are both Chinese citizens and both have settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled abroad. Starting from 2021, the applicant who applies to study at WMU as international students, in addition to meeting other application requirements of our university, should hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive) and have actually resided in a foreign country for more than 2 years in the recent 4 years (before April 30 of the year of admission) (the actual resided in a foreign country for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit signature);(2) Residents of mainland China (mainland), Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who have immigrated and acquire foreign nationality and apply to study as international students at WMU should also meet the requirement (1).2. Graduated from high school or equivalent, scores (including physics, chemistry and biology) meeting admission requirements;3. In good health, abide by Chinese laws and regulations of the university.Note: All medical related majors do not recruit students who are color blindness. Left-hander is not qualified by the BDS program.
